title: Coke Burgers
protein_note: Whatever is in the freezer — mixed meat patties
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until softened. Strain and cool completely. Freeze 45 minutes.
Combine cooled onion, ground meat, eggs, bread crumbs, and seasoning. Mix well.
Add 3/4 can cola. Mix in. Marinate in fridge a couple of hours.
Grill: get grill extremely hot. Ensure burners are free of debris.
Sear one side longer to avoid patties falling apart.
Flip when basted on touch — color does not indicate doneness.
Buns: sauté garlic in butter. Toast buns. Generously coat with butter-garlic mixture.
